highlights.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI's agents buy things for you
highlights.description: OpenAI today announced ChatGPT Wallet, a new feature that lets its Dots AI agents complete purchases on your behalf. It was built in partnership with American Express, Mastercard, and Visa, and is initially only available for ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US. The idea is simple. You add a card to the Wallet once, then ask your dot to help you find something to buy, like a new sweater or a hotel for your next trip. other.title: Huawei's next nova Flip could switch to a wide form factor
other.description: Huawei launched the nova Flip S in China back in October last year, and it was mostly the nova Flip with new colors, a lower price, and a different chipset. Its successor is rumored to be a much bigger change, though.
